# Anti-Theft

> Anti-Theft is an Android anti-theft app that lets you remotely control and protect your device from a web dashboard.

## Features
- Remote Screenshot Capture
- Quick Settings Block on lock screen
- Shutdown Protection
- Remote Silent Mode
- Live Location Tracking
- Multi-Device Support

## Pricing
- Free tier available
- Pro plan: $1/year

## Platform
- Android 8.0 (API 26) and above
